notes.content: Thank you for your interest in CSU Dominguez Hills! This articulation agreement displays lower-division course requirements specific to this major. Students are advised to meet with an academic counselor when planning to transfer to CSU Dominguez Hills and refer to the University Catalog to learn more about this major and its features. Detailed admissions requirements for transfer students are available on the CSUDH campus website . Completion of Statutory Requirements (United States History, Constitution and American Ideals) is a baccalaureate degree requirement for the California State University system and may be met prior to transfer with eligible California Community College (CCC) courses designated as US-1, US-2, and US-3. Completion of Statutory Requirements prior to transfer is most advantageous and strongly encouraged as a number of CCC courses that meet this requirement might also double-count for General Education.

notes.content: The English Education Option satisfies Subject Matter Preparation Program in English (SMPP) requirements. The SMPP is designed for students interested in a career in teaching English at the secondary school level (grades 6-12). This program satisfies the requirements set by the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing for demonstrating substantive preparation in the subject matter field of English. Completion of this approved program or passing a comprehensive examination in English fulfills one part of the requirements leading to the Single Subject teaching Credential in English. All English Education Option students must select one of the following Extended Studies : Communications - Lower division required courses: COM 250 Literature Teaching English as a Second Language - Lower division required course: ENG 210 Theatre Arts - No lower division required courses See catalog for Extended Studies upper division required courses: https://catalog.csudh.edu/academics/english/english-ba/
notes.contentHtml:
The English Education Option satisfies Subject Matter Preparation Program in English (SMPP) requirements. The SMPP is designed for students interested in a career in teaching English at the secondary school level (grades 6-12). This program satisfies the requirements set by the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing for demonstrating substantive preparation in the subject matter field of English. Completion of this approved program or passing a comprehensive examination in English fulfills one part of the requirements leading to the Single Subject teaching Credential in English. All English Education Option students must select one of the following Extended Studies:


  • Communications - Lower division required courses: COM 250
  • Literature
  • Teaching English as a Second Language - Lower division required course: ENG 210
  • Theatre Arts - No lower division required courses


See catalog for Extended Studies upper division required courses: https://catalog.csudh.edu/academics/english/english-ba/
